head: A Life in the Making: a self reflection journal app for iPhone
dek: A Life in the Making is a $4.99 iPhone app with guided self reflection exercises on your values, your story, your thoughts and your relationships, and you don't need an account. It was #92 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: Its sections include a Start Here guide, My Living Compass, Your Story, Thoughts & Beliefs, The Miracle Question, Values & Meaning, Relationships and Intentions Into Action, plus optional calendar reminders. Reflections can be saved and exported as a journal. The listing says it draws on ideas from narrative therapy, ACT, CBT and other approaches, presented as self-guided reflection, and that it isn't therapy or a replacement for professional care. It came out on 18 November and needs iOS 27.2.
means: If you journal or want prompts to think about your goals and values, this app gives guided exercises for a one-time price; it isn't a substitute for a therapist.
todo: Search "A Life in the Making" in the App Store; export your reflections now and then to keep a copy.
